consumers.reason: load_json_strict: object_pairs_hook rejects a duplicate key, non-finite numbers and a BOM
delegates to instrument_qualify.load_registry, which is load_json_strict
runs `instrument_qualify.py check --registry`, so the parser is the strict one
load_instruments uses harden.loads, which refuses a duplicate key, a BOM, trailing data and non-finite numbers
_instrument_entries uses harden.loads and raises JsonError on a refusal, so a duplicate key no longer resolves last-wins
names the register as a subject and hashes its bytes; it does not parse it, so a parse-level difference is not observed here
binds the register by digest only

reported.finding: no tracked consumer accepts the duplicate-key document: both etp_t1_seed.load_instruments and freshness._instrument_entries now refuse it with PH_REFUSED_DUPLICATE_KEY. The earlier finding that those two consumers read the register with plain json.loads is historical (repaired in e4029e0d5).
reported.history: on 6e64e644c etp_t1_seed.py (ETP-T1) and freshness.py (A7) read the register with plain json.loads; both now read it with harden.loads and refuse a duplicate key
reported.scope: the duplicate-key input is the A11 pair {"a":1,"a":2}

experiments.title: Strict parser versus a permissive consumer

probes.means: the harness reports DEFECT when the instrument accepted the input
a detector that accepts any observation reports QUALIFIED on the same input, so the strict detector is what produces the verdict
the harness does see a refusal when the instrument produces one

experiments.notes: the policy is the live A20 policy with one field changed and its digest recomputed, so the shape refusal is the one under test

reported.accepted_note: the live policy evaluates to DENY with no refusal code; a denial is not a refusal code and the accepted witness requires only that no refusal code fires
reported.omission_mutated: verify compares the envelope payload with the canonical reconciliation bytes before checking the reconciliation
reported.omission_pass_with_missing: verify re-derives the summary and refuses a PASS while a required member is MISSING
reported.pin_digest_note: the `pin=` digest in the engine's output is recorded as <pin-digest>: the pin embeds the run's temporary policy path, so its digest is not comparable across runs. The policy digest, which is what the refusal is about, is left exactly as printed
